title: Files read failure also renders an empty-library or empty-captures claim
reproduction: Open Files as a signed-in user with the selected organization set and no cached rows.
Inspect the active Library or Screenshots tab after loading ends.
expected: Show the read error and retry state without describing the collection as empty.
actual: reload sets state to error and displays the error banner, but both tab panels branch only on state === loading and then use an empty-row test; the active panel additionally says ‘No library files yet’ or ‘No captures yet’.
severity: S3: an error is accompanied by a contradictory empty-state claim
priority: P2: user may infer files or screenshots do not exist
